newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Costello sees strong labour demand.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Costello sees strong labour demand.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Monday earlier released jobs vacancies figures showed continuing jobs growth and solid labour demand.

Citing an increase in ANZ job figures released on Monday, Costello told parliament: "That rise will be welcomed, I hope, by all Australians as indicating continuing jobs growth in the Australian economy."
And Australian Bureau of Statistics job vacancies figures released last month showed an even stronger result, he said.
"The level of ABS job vacancies is consistent with the view that demand for labour remains solid," he said.
The bureau figures showed a 7.9 percent rise in job vacancies between August and November,
ANZ job advertisement figures released earlier on Monday showed a 3.3 percent seasonally-adjusted rise in advertisements in January, the largest monthly gain since January last year.
In its mid-year review of its budget and the economy, released last month, the government forecast employment to grow 1.5 percent in the year to June 30, 1997.
